title: Vercel Webhook Listener
reason: We need this skill because Vercel workflows degrade when unverified events can trigger unsafe downstream actions. This specific skill turns Vercel Webhook Listener into a deterministic, auth-checked workflow for captures, verifies, and routes vercel webhook events..
implementationGuide: Define the accepted event types, replay window, and downstream side effects for Vercel Webhook Listener, then register the signing-secret policy for Vercel.
Validate credential reuse for the listener and verify that signature, timestamp, and dedupe stores are all healthy before accepting events.
Implement captures, verifies, and routes vercel webhook events. so that every payload is verified, normalized, and either routed or quarantined deterministically.
Preserve accepted event IDs, quarantine references, and downstream trigger artifacts for every dispatch decision.
Run simulation and regression suites that cover invalid signatures, replay attacks, duplicate deliveries, and routing-policy violations.
Publish an event-intake log with accepted IDs, quarantined deliveries, and any replay guidance needed for downstream operators.

humanUseCases: Receive external provider events without trusting unsigned, replayed, or schema-drifted payloads.
Quarantine ambiguous events while preserving enough trace data to replay safely.

preflight: Validate the signing secret, replay window, and dedupe cache before accepting live events.
Confirm the routing rules and downstream side effects that each event type may trigger.
execution: Verify signatures and timestamps before deserializing the payload.
Route verified events through a dedupe check and quarantine anything that violates policy.
recovery: Pause live acceptance when signature verification or replay detection regresses.
Replay only from the quarantine queue after the root cause is corrected.
handoff: Return accepted event IDs, quarantined deliveries, and downstream trigger references.
Document the active replay window and any signature policy overrides used during recovery.

guardrails.rule: Reject unsigned or replayed events before any downstream side effects are triggered.
Persist a quarantine queue for every event that cannot be safely dispatched.
Route policy-violating payloads to manual review instead of auto-retrying.

alertTriggers: schema or contract regressions persist for two consecutive runs
critical posture or rollback events exceed tolerance
